entries.original: Increase the wire size (each AWG step cuts drop about 21%), raise the system voltage (240 V vs 120 V is a 4x improvement for the same watts), shorten the run, or use a step-up transformer for very long distances.
entries.translation: 加大导线规格（线规）（每加大一个 AWG 档，压降约减少 21%）、提高系统电压（同样的瓦数下，240 V 比 120 V 改善 4x）、缩短线路，或者对非常长的距离使用升压变压器。
entries.backTranslation: Increase the wire size (gauge) (each AWG size up cuts the drop by about 21%), raise the system voltage (at the same wattage, 240 V is a 4x improvement over 120 V), shorten the run, or use a step-up transformer for very long distances.

entries.original: is the round trip — current flows out and back, so measure your distance
entries.translation: 代表往返距离 —— 电流有去有回，所以量距离时只量
entries.backTranslation: stands for the round-trip distance — the current goes out and comes back, so when you measure the distance, measure only

entries.original: Measure one-way, from the source to the load. The standard formula's factor of 2 accounts for the round trip. Entering round-trip length into a one-way calculator doubles your error — the most common cause of disagreeing results.
entries.translation: 量单程，从电源量到负载。标准公式里的系数 2 已经把往返距离算进去了。把往返距离填进按单程计算的计算器，误差直接翻倍 —— 这是结果对不上的最常见原因。
entries.backTranslation: Measure one-way, from the source to the load. The factor of 2 in the standard formula already accounts for the round trip. Entering the round-trip distance into a calculator that works on one-way doubles the error outright — this is the most common reason results don't match.

entries.original: measure THIS: one-way distance (the formula doubles it)
entries.translation: 量的就是这一段：单程距离（仅去程）—— 公式会自动加倍
entries.backTranslation: This is the stretch you measure: the one-way distance (outbound leg only) — the formula doubles it automatically

entries.original: Mostly it's a performance problem — dim lights, hot motors, slow chargers — but chronically undervolted motors can overheat and fail, and the lost energy becomes heat in the wiring. Severe drop is a sign the circuit needs redesign.
entries.translation: 多数情况下只是性能问题 —— 灯偏暗、电机发烫、充电变慢 —— 但长期欠压的电机可能过热损坏，损失的电能会在布线里变成热量。压降严重就说明这条电路需要重新设计。
entries.backTranslation: In most cases it is only a performance problem — dim lights, hot motors, slower charging — but a motor left under-voltage long-term can overheat and be damaged, and the lost energy turns into heat in the wiring. A severe drop means the circuit needs to be redesigned.

entries.original: shorten the route
entries.translation: 缩短走线路径
entries.backTranslation: shorten the routing

entries.original: . Too much — go to #10 or shorten the run.
entries.translation: 。太大了 —— 改用 #10 或者缩短线路。
entries.backTranslation: . Too much — change to #10 or shorten the run.

entries.original: A 32 A continuous charger produces a 40 A sizing load: 32 A × 1.25 = 40 A. The charger must be set and listed for that circuit, and the conductor still has to pass the installation's ampacity and distance checks.
entries.translation: 32 A 连续负载的充电桩会产生 40 A 的选线负载：32 A × 1.25 = 40 A。充电桩必须为该电路设置并获得认证，导体仍要通过该安装现场的载流量和距离检查。
entries.backTranslation: A charging station with a 32 A continuous load produces a 40 A conductor-selection load: 32 A × 1.25 = 40 A. The charging station must be set and certified for that circuit, and the conductors must still pass the ampacity and distance checks for that installation site.

entries.original: A range is the classic 40 A circuit. A 32 A continuous EV load also lands on a 40 A circuit because 32 A × 1.25 = 40 A; confirm the charger's setting and installation instructions.
entries.translation: 炉灶是最经典的 40 A 电路。32 A 的连续电动车负载也会落在 40 A 电路上，因为 32 A × 1.25 = 40 A；请核对充电桩的设置和安装说明书。
entries.backTranslation: A range is the most classic 40 A circuit. A 32 A continuous EV load also lands on a 40 A circuit, because 32 A × 1.25 = 40 A; check the charging station's setting and its installation instructions.

entries.original: The verified ampacity table gives #8 copper 40 A in the 60°C column and 50 A in the 75°C column. That makes #8 the minimum at ordinary conditions in either case, but the available headroom is different.
entries.translation: 经核验的载流量表显示，#8 铜线在 60°C 那一栏额定 40 A，在 75°C 那一栏额定 50 A。两种情况下常规条件的最小规格都是 #8，但可用的余量不一样。
entries.backTranslation: The verified ampacity table shows #8 copper rated 40 A in the 60°C column and 50 A in the 75°C column. In both cases the minimum size under normal conditions is #8, but the available headroom is different.

entries.original: Our verified calculator selects #6 copper (26,240 circular mils): 2 × 12.9 × 40 × 150 ÷ 26,240 = 5.90 V, or 2.46% of 240 V. #8 passes ampacity but does not meet the 3% drop target at this distance.
entries.translation: 我们已核验的计算器选出 #6 铜线（26,240 cmil）：2 × 12.9 × 40 × 150 ÷ 26,240 = 5.90 V，相当于 240 V 的 2.46%。#8 能通过载流量检查，但在这个距离上达不到 3% 电压降目标。
entries.backTranslation: Our verified calculator selects #6 copper (26,240 cmil): 2 × 12.9 × 40 × 150 ÷ 26,240 = 5.90 V, equivalent to 2.46% of 240 V. #8 can pass the ampacity check, but at this distance it does not meet the 3% voltage-drop target.

entries.original: Yes, under ordinary conditions when the wiring method and termination rating support the applicable ampacity column. Heat, bundled conductors, and long distance can require a larger conductor.
entries.translation: 可以，前提是布线方式和端子额定值支持所适用的载流量栏，且处于常规条件下。高温、成束敷设的导线和长距离都可能要求更大的导体。
entries.backTranslation: Yes, provided the wiring method and terminal ratings support the applicable ampacity column, and conditions are normal. High temperature, bundled conductors, and long distances can all require a larger conductor.

entries.original: This table starts with the NEC 310.12 dwelling-service minimum, then raises the conductor when needed to keep calculated drop at or under the 3% planning target. It uses 240 V, the full 100 A rating, and one-way distance.
entries.translation: 这张表从 NEC 310.12 住宅供电进线的最小规格开始，需要时再加大导体，把计算出的电压降控制在 3% 规划目标以内。它按 240 V、满载 100 A 计算，距离为单程。
entries.backTranslation: This table starts from the NEC 310.12 residential service minimum size, then upsizes the conductor when needed to keep the calculated voltage drop within the 3% planning target. It calculates at 240 V, the full 100 A load, and one-way distance.

entries.original: 100 A × 83% = 83 A → 4 AWG copper (85 A at 75 °C); 2 AWG aluminum (90 A at 75 °C).
entries.translation: 100 A × 83% = 83 A → 4 AWG 铜线（75°C 下额定 85 A）；2 AWG 铝线（75°C 下额定 90 A）。
entries.backTranslation: 100 A × 83% = 83 A → 4 AWG copper (rated 85 A at 75°C); 2 AWG aluminum (rated 90 A at 75°C).

entries.original: No ampacity adjustment or correction factors can be required.
entries.translation: 前提是不需要任何载流量调整系数或校正系数。
entries.backTranslation: The precondition is that no ampacity adjustment factor or correction factor is required.

entries.original: No. NM/Romex is treated as a 60 °C assembly, while this dwelling-service allowance requires conductors rated 75 °C or better.
entries.translation: 不适用。NM/Romex 按 60°C 组件处理，而这项住宅供电进线的放宽规定要求导体额定 75°C 或以上。
entries.backTranslation: No. NM/Romex is treated as a 60°C assembly, and this residential service relaxation requires conductors rated 75°C or higher.

entries.original: Yes for a qualifying 100 A dwelling service: the 83% calculation requires 83 A, and 4 AWG copper is rated 85 A in the verified 75 °C table. Otherwise, check the actual method in the Ampacity Check tool.
entries.translation: 对于符合条件的 100 A 住宅供电进线，答案是够的：83% 的计算要求 83 A，而经核验的 75°C 表格里 4 AWG 铜线额定 85 A。否则，请到载流量检查工具中核对实际适用的方法。
entries.backTranslation: For a qualifying 100 A residential service, the answer is that it is enough: the 83% calculation requires 83 A, and in the verified 75°C table 4 AWG copper is rated 85 A. Otherwise, go to the ampacity check tool to verify the method that actually applies.

entries.original: The service or feeder rating must be from 100 A through 400 A.
entries.translation: 供电进线或馈线的额定值必须在 100 A 至 400 A 范围内（含两端）。
entries.backTranslation: The service or feeder rating must be within the range of 100 A to 400 A (inclusive of both ends).

entries.original: A 100 A dwelling service that meets NEC 310.12 can use 4 AWG copper or 2 AWG aluminum. That is a service answer, not a general 100 A feeder answer.
entries.translation: 符合 NEC 310.12 的 100 A 住宅供电进线可以用 4 AWG 铜线或 2 AWG 铝线。这是供电进线的答案，不是一般 100 A 馈线的答案。
entries.backTranslation: A 100 A residential service that meets NEC 310.12 can use 4 AWG copper or 2 AWG aluminum. This is the service answer, not the answer for a general 100 A feeder.

entries.original: Plain 75 °C table: 100 A → 3 AWG copper (100 A) or 1 AWG aluminum (100 A).
entries.translation: 普通 75°C 表格：100 A → 3 AWG 铜线（100 A）或 1 AWG 铝线（100 A）。
entries.backTranslation: Plain 75°C table: 100 A → 3 AWG copper (100 A) or 1 AWG aluminum (100 A).

entries.original: Without the dwelling-service allowance, use the ordinary ampacity table and the temperature method the installation permits. This includes non-dwelling work and any installation where derating applies. At 75 °C, the verified table selects 3 AWG copper or 1 AWG aluminum. A 60 °C method needs its own lookup and cannot borrow the 75 °C result.
entries.translation: 如果不适用住宅供电进线的放宽规定，就要用普通载流量表，以及该安装现场允许的温度方法。这包括非住宅工程，以及任何需要降容的安装。在 75°C 下，经核验的表格选出 3 AWG 铜线或 1 AWG 铝线。60°C 方法需要单独查表，不能直接借用 75°C 的结果。
entries.backTranslation: If the residential service relaxation does not apply, use the plain ampacity table and the temperature method allowed at that installation site. This includes non-dwelling projects, and any installation that requires derating. At 75°C, the verified table selects 3 AWG copper or 1 AWG aluminum. The 60°C method requires its own separate table lookup and cannot directly borrow the 75°C result.

entries.original: Conductors must be rated 75 °C or better. NM/Romex is a 60 °C assembly, so it is out.
entries.translation: 导体必须额定 75°C 或以上。NM/Romex 是 60°C 组件，所以不符合。
entries.backTranslation: Conductors must be rated 75°C or higher. NM/Romex is a 60°C assembly, so it does not qualify.

entries.original: Dwelling service or a feeder carrying the entire dwelling load only — never a branch circuit or a non-dwelling installation.
entries.translation: 仅限住宅供电进线，或承担整栋住宅负载的馈线——绝不适用于分支电路或非住宅安装。
entries.backTranslation: Only a residential service, or a feeder carrying the entire dwelling load — never a branch circuit or a non-dwelling installation.

entries.original: A 48 A continuous charger produces a 60 A sizing load: 48 A × 1.25 = 60 A. Confirm the charger's permitted setting, wiring method, terminal ratings, and local requirements.
entries.translation: 48 A 连续负载的充电桩会产生 60 A 的选线负载：48 A × 1.25 = 60 A。请核对充电桩的允许设置、布线方式、端子额定值和当地要求。
entries.backTranslation: A charging station with a 48 A continuous load produces a 60 A conductor-selection load: 48 A × 1.25 = 60 A. Check the charging station's permitted settings, the wiring method, terminal ratings, and local requirements.

entries.original: A 48 A continuous EV charger produces a 60 A sizing load: 48 A × 1.25 = 60 A. Other common jobs include sub-panel feeds and larger heat-pump or mini-split circuits; follow the equipment nameplate.
entries.translation: 48 A 连续负载的电动车充电桩会产生 60 A 的选线负载：48 A × 1.25 = 60 A。其他常见用途还包括子配电盘馈电，以及更大的热泵或分体空调电路；请以设备铭牌为准。
entries.backTranslation: An EV charging station with a 48 A continuous load produces a 60 A conductor-selection load: 48 A × 1.25 = 60 A. Other common uses also include subpanel feeders, and larger heat-pump or mini-split air-conditioning circuits; go by the equipment nameplate.

entries.original: The copper answer splits by temperature column: #6 at 75°C, but #4 at 60°C. Check the cable type and terminal markings before choosing between them.
entries.translation: 铜线的答案按温度栏一分为二：75°C 用 #6，60°C 用 #4。选用前请检查电缆类型和端子标示。
entries.backTranslation: The copper answer splits in two by temperature column: #6 for 75°C, #4 for 60°C. Check the cable type and terminal markings before selecting.

entries.original: The verified 75°C column gives #6 copper 65 A, so it passes 60 A. The verified 60°C column gives #6 copper only 55 A, so that method selects #4 copper at 70 A. This page does not use a next-size-up exception to make #6 pass at 60°C.
entries.translation: 经核验的 75°C 那一栏给 #6 铜线额定 65 A，所以能通过 60 A。经核验的 60°C 那一栏只给 #6 铜线 55 A，所以那种方法要选 #4 铜线，额定 70 A。本页不使用“下一级规格”的例外规定来让 #6 在 60°C 下也能通过。
entries.backTranslation: The verified 75°C column rates #6 copper at 65 A, so it passes for 60 A. The verified 60°C column gives #6 copper only 55 A, so that method must select #4 copper, rated 70 A. This page does not use the "next size up" exception rule to let #6 also pass at 60°C.

entries.original: Our verified calculator selects #4 copper (41,740 circular mils): 2 × 12.9 × 60 × 150 ÷ 41,740 = 5.56 V, or 2.32% of 240 V. Distance now governs over the #6 copper 75°C ampacity floor.
entries.translation: 我们已核验的计算器选出 #4 铜线（41,740 cmil）：2 × 12.9 × 60 × 150 ÷ 41,740 = 5.56 V，相当于 240 V 的 2.32%。此时起决定作用的是距离，而不是 #6 铜线在 75°C 下的载流量下限。
entries.backTranslation: Our verified calculator selects #4 copper (41,740 cmil): 2 × 12.9 × 60 × 150 ÷ 41,740 = 5.56 V, which is 2.32% of 240 V. Here distance is the deciding factor, not the ampacity floor of #6 copper at 75°C.

entries.original: A TT-30 RV receptacle is 120 V. Start with 10 AWG copper at ordinary distances, then use the 120 V table or calculator for the actual one-way run.
entries.translation: TT-30 房车插座是 120 V。普通距离下先从 10 AWG 铜线开始，实际单程距离请查 120 V 表格或用计算器。
entries.backTranslation: The TT-30 RV receptacle is 120 V. At ordinary distances start with 10 AWG copper; for your actual one-way distance, check the 120 V table or use the calculator.

entries.original: The verified ampacity table supports #8 aluminum at 30 A under ordinary 75°C termination conditions, so aluminum is included. Confirm the conductor type, terminals, and equipment listing before using it.
entries.translation: 经核验的载流量表显示，在常规 75°C 端子条件下，#8 铝线的载流量支持 30 A，因此这里把铝线也列了进来。使用前请确认导体类型、端子和设备的认证标示。
entries.backTranslation: The verified ampacity table shows that under ordinary 75°C termination conditions, #8 aluminum's ampacity supports 30 A, so aluminum is also listed here. Before using it, confirm the conductor type, the terminations, and the equipment's certification markings.

entries.original: No. NEC 240.4(D) caps 12 AWG copper at 20 A for ordinary circuits, so it does not pass a 30 A ampacity check.
entries.translation: 不行。NEC 240.4(D) 规定普通电路中 12 AWG 铜线最高只能配 20 A，所以它通不过 30 A 的载流量检查。
entries.backTranslation: No. NEC 240.4(D) says 12 AWG copper in ordinary circuits may be paired with at most 20 A, so it fails the 30 A ampacity check.

entries.original: Start with 10 AWG copper for an ordinary 30 A circuit. A TT-30 RV receptacle is 120 V, while a typical dryer or water-heater circuit is 240 V; that voltage difference changes long-run sizing.
entries.translation: 普通 30 A 电路先从 10 AWG 铜线开始。TT-30 房车插座是 120 V，而典型的烘干机或热水器电路是 240 V；这个电压差会改变长距离布线的选线结果。
entries.backTranslation: Ordinary 30 A circuits start with 10 AWG copper. The TT-30 RV receptacle is 120 V, while a typical dryer or water heater circuit is 240 V; this voltage difference changes the wire-selection result for long runs.

entries.original: At 120 V, our verified calculator selects #6 copper (26,240 circular mils): 2 × 12.9 × 30 × 100 ÷ 26,240 = 2.95 V, or 2.46%. The 240 V table is smaller because the same volts lost are half the percentage.
entries.translation: 在 120 V 下，我们已核验的计算器选出 #6 铜线（26,240 cmil）：2 × 12.9 × 30 × 100 ÷ 26,240 = 2.95 V，相当于 2.46%。240 V 表格里的规格更小，因为损失同样的伏特数，占比只是一半。
entries.backTranslation: At 120 V, our verified calculator selects #6 copper (26,240 cmil): 2 × 12.9 × 30 × 100 ÷ 26,240 = 2.95 V, which is 2.46%. The sizes in the 240 V table are smaller because losing the same number of volts is only half the percentage.

entries.original: Use 12 AWG copper for an ordinary 20 A branch circuit. NEC 240.4(D) caps 14 AWG copper at 15 A, so it cannot be protected by a 20 A breaker for this ordinary use.
entries.translation: 普通 20 A 分支电路请用 12 AWG 铜线。NEC 240.4(D) 规定 14 AWG 铜线最高只能配 15 A 断路器，因此这种常规用途不能用 20 A 断路器保护。
entries.backTranslation: For an ordinary 20 A branch circuit, use 12 AWG copper. NEC 240.4(D) says 14 AWG copper may be paired with at most a 15 A breaker, so for this ordinary use it cannot be protected by a 20 A breaker.

entries.original: NEC 240.4(D) caps 14 AWG copper at 15 A and 12 AWG copper at 20 A for ordinary circuits. A larger raw ampacity in another temperature column does not erase that cap.
entries.translation: NEC 240.4(D) 规定，普通电路中 14 AWG 铜线最高配 15 A、12 AWG 铜线最高配 20 A。哪怕在其他温度栏里额定载流量更大，也不能突破这个上限。
entries.backTranslation: NEC 240.4(D) says that in ordinary circuits, 14 AWG copper is capped at 15 A and 12 AWG copper at 20 A. Even if the rated ampacity is larger in other temperature columns, this ceiling cannot be exceeded.

entries.original: Our verified calculator selects #8 copper (16,510 circular mils): 2 × 12.9 × 20 × 100 ÷ 16,510 = 3.13 V, or 2.6% of 120 V. It passes both the ampacity check and the 3% drop target.
entries.translation: 我们已核验的计算器选出 #8 铜线（16,510 cmil）：2 × 12.9 × 20 × 100 ÷ 16,510 = 3.13 V，相当于 120 V 的 2.6%。它同时通过了载流量检查和 3% 电压降目标。
entries.backTranslation: Our verified calculator selects #8 copper (16,510 cmil): 2 × 12.9 × 20 × 100 ÷ 16,510 = 3.13 V, which is 2.6% of 120 V. It passes both the ampacity check and the 3% voltage-drop target.

entries.original: This table begins with the NEC 310.12 dwelling-service minimum, then raises the conductor when the calculated drop would exceed the 3% planning target. It uses 240 V, the full 200 A rating, and one-way distance.
entries.translation: 这张表从 NEC 310.12 住宅供电进线的最小规格开始，当计算出的电压降会超过 3% 规划目标时再加大导体。它按 240 V、满载 200 A 计算，距离为单程。
entries.backTranslation: This table starts from the NEC 310.12 minimum size for residential services and upsizes the conductor when the calculated voltage drop would exceed the 3% planning target. It is computed at 240 V with a full 200 A load, and distances are one-way.

entries.original: 200 A × 83% = 166 A → 2/0 AWG copper (175 A at 75 °C); 4/0 AWG aluminum (180 A at 75 °C).
entries.backTranslation: 200 A × 83% = 166 A → 2/0 AWG copper (rated 175 A at 75°C); 4/0 AWG aluminum (rated 180 A at 75°C).

entries.original: For a qualifying dwelling service, use 4/0 aluminum. Without the allowance, the verified 75 °C table requires 250 kcmil aluminum for 200 A.
entries.translation: 对于符合条件的住宅供电进线，请用 4/0 铝线。不适用放宽规定时，经核验的 75°C 表格要求 200 A 用 250 kcmil 铝线。
entries.backTranslation: For a qualifying residential service, use 4/0 aluminum. When the allowance does not apply, the verified 75°C table requires 250 kcmil aluminum for 200 A.

entries.original: No ampacity adjustment or correction factors can be required.
entries.translation: 前提是不需要任何载流量调整系数或校正系数。
entries.backTranslation: Provided that no ampacity adjustment factors or correction factors are needed.

entries.original: No. NM/Romex is a 60 °C assembly, and the dwelling-service allowance requires conductors rated 75 °C or better.
entries.translation: 不适用。NM/Romex 是 60°C 组件，而住宅供电进线的放宽规定要求导体额定 75°C 或以上。
entries.backTranslation: It does not qualify. NM/Romex is a 60°C assembly, while the residential-service allowance requires conductors rated 75°C or above.

entries.original: The service or feeder rating must be from 100 A through 400 A.
entries.translation: 供电进线或馈线的额定值必须在 100 A 至 400 A 范围内（含两端）。
entries.backTranslation: The service or feeder rating must be in the range of 100 A to 400 A (inclusive of both ends).

entries.original: Plain 75 °C table: 200 A → 3/0 AWG copper (200 A) or 250 kcmil aluminum (205 A).
entries.translation: 普通 75°C 表格：200 A → 3/0 AWG 铜线（200 A）或 250 kcmil 铝线（205 A）。
entries.backTranslation: Ordinary 75°C table: 200 A → 3/0 AWG copper (200 A) or 250 kcmil aluminum (205 A).

entries.original: 250 kcmil
entries.translation: 250 kcmil
entries.backTranslation: 250 kcmil

entries.original: 300 kcmil
entries.translation: 300 kcmil
entries.backTranslation: 300 kcmil

entries.original: 400 kcmil
entries.translation: 400 kcmil
entries.backTranslation: 400 kcmil

entries.original: Conductors must be rated 75 °C or better. NM/Romex is a 60 °C assembly, so it is out.
entries.translation: 导体必须额定 75°C 或以上。NM/Romex 是 60°C 组件，所以不符合。
entries.backTranslation: Conductors must be rated 75°C or above. NM/Romex is a 60°C assembly, so it does not qualify.

entries.original: 2/0 AWG copper is the NEC 310.12 dwelling-service answer. 3/0 AWG copper is the plain 310.16 answer at 75 °C when that allowance does not apply. 4/0 AWG aluminum is the dwelling-service aluminum answer; the plain 75 °C table instead selects 250 kcmil aluminum.
entries.translation: 2/0 AWG 铜线是 NEC 310.12 住宅供电进线的答案。当该放宽规定不适用时，3/0 AWG 铜线是 75°C 下普通 310.16 的答案。4/0 AWG 铝线是住宅供电进线的铝线答案；普通 75°C 表格则改选 250 kcmil 铝线。
entries.backTranslation: 2/0 AWG copper is the NEC 310.12 residential-service answer. When that allowance does not apply, 3/0 AWG copper is the ordinary 310.16 answer at 75°C. 4/0 AWG aluminum is the aluminum residential-service answer; the ordinary 75°C table instead selects 250 kcmil aluminum.

entries.original: Use 2/0 copper for a dwelling service or whole-dwelling feeder that meets every NEC 310.12 condition. Use 3/0 copper for the plain 75 °C Table 310.16 method when the allowance does not apply.
entries.translation: 符合 NEC 310.12 全部条件的住宅供电进线或整栋住宅馈线，请用 2/0 铜线。放宽规定不适用时，普通 75°C Table 310.16 方法请用 3/0 铜线。
entries.backTranslation: For a residential service or whole-dwelling feeder that meets all NEC 310.12 conditions, use 2/0 copper. When the allowance does not apply, use 3/0 copper under the ordinary 75°C Table 310.16 method.

entries.original: Yes, when the 200 A installation qualifies for NEC 310.12 and the conductors and equipment are suitable for aluminum. The 83% requirement is 166 A, and 4/0 aluminum is rated 180 A at 75 °C.
entries.translation: 可以，前提是 200 A 安装符合 NEC 310.12，且导体和设备适用于铝线。83% 的要求是 166 A，而 4/0 铝线在 75°C 下额定 180 A。
entries.backTranslation: Yes, provided the 200 A installation qualifies under NEC 310.12 and the conductors and equipment are suitable for aluminum. The 83% requirement is 166 A, and 4/0 aluminum is rated 180 A at 75°C.

entries.original: Dwelling service or a feeder carrying the entire dwelling load only — never a branch circuit or a non-dwelling installation.
entries.translation: 仅限住宅供电进线，或承担整栋住宅负载的馈线——绝不适用于分支电路或非住宅安装。
entries.backTranslation: Only residential services, or feeders that carry the entire dwelling load — never branch circuits or non-dwelling installations.

entries.original: After a table passes, we take a fingerprint of it and store that fingerprint in the repository. From then on, if a single digit in that table changes, the verification suite stops before the browser checks and reports the mismatch. Re-verifying the data and deliberately updating the fingerprint are separate human steps, not something the seal can enforce by itself.
entries.translation: 数据表通过核查后，我们会计算其数字指纹，并把指纹保存在代码仓库中。此后，只要表中有一个数字发生变化，验证套件就会在浏览器测试开始前停止，并报告不一致。重新核查数据和有意更新所存指纹是两个独立的人工步骤，封印本身无法强制执行。
entries.backTranslation: After a data table passes review, we calculate its digital fingerprint and store the fingerprint in the code repository. From then on, if a single number in the table changes, the verification suite stops before the browser tests begin and reports the discrepancy. Rechecking the data and deliberately updating the stored fingerprint are two separate human steps; the seal itself cannot enforce them.

entries.original: Back-translation catches missing warnings and mangled meaning. It is a screen, not proof.
entries.translation: 回译可以发现遗漏的警告和被扭曲的含义。它是一道筛查，不是正确性的证明。
entries.backTranslation: Back translation can detect missing warnings and distorted meanings. It is a screening step, not proof of correctness.

entries.original: The seal proves a number hasn't changed without somebody noticing. It doesn't prove the original was right. That's what the multi-source check is for. They're separate protections and they do separate jobs.
entries.translation: 封印能够证明数字没有在无人察觉的情况下发生变化，但不能证明原始数字一定正确。原始数据是否正确由多来源核查负责。这是两道不同的保护，各自完成不同的任务。
entries.backTranslation: The seal can prove that a number did not change without anyone noticing, but it cannot prove that the original number was correct. Verifying whether the original data is correct is the role of the multiple-source check. These are two different protections, each performing a different task.

entries.original: Codes are adopted locally and amended locally. The edition in force where you're standing may not be the one a table came from.
entries.translation: 各地自行采用并修订电气规范。您施工地点现行的版本，可能不是某张数据表所依据的版本。
entries.backTranslation: Electrical codes are adopted and amended locally. The edition currently in effect at your work location may not be the edition on which a particular data table is based.

entries.original: US ampacity data reflects NEC Table 310.16 and the 310.15(B)(1) correction factors as published in the 2023 edition (NFPA 70). Small-conductor caps come from 240.4(D), conduit fill from Chapter 9 Tables 4 and 5, and box fill from 314.16. These particular tables have been stable across editions. That is why a slightly different adopted edition usually does not change the answer. State and municipal adoption varies; confirm the edition adopted locally.
entries.translation: 美国版载流量数据采用 2023 edition (NFPA 70) 发布的 NEC Table 310.16 和 310.15(B)(1) 修正系数。小导线限制来自 240.4(D)，导管填充来自 Chapter 9 Tables 4 and 5，接线盒填充来自 314.16。这些特定表格在各版之间一直保持稳定，因此当地采用的版本即使略有不同，通常也不会改变答案。各州和市政地区的采用情况不同；请确认当地采用的版本。
entries.backTranslation: The US ampacity data uses NEC Table 310.16 and the 310.15(B)(1) correction factors published in the 2023 edition (NFPA 70). Small conductor limits come from 240.4(D), conduit fill from Chapter 9 Tables 4 and 5, and box fill from 314.16. These specific tables have remained stable between editions, so even if the locally adopted edition is slightly different, it usually will not change the answer. Adoption varies by state and municipality; confirm the locally adopted edition.

entries.original: Every calculator is driven in all six editions, not just English, and the answer is checked against an expected value — hand-worked for the core voltage-drop cases, and derived from the sealed tables for the rest. We learned this one the hard way: a test run that drove only English once reported a clean pass while the main calculator was dead in four other editions.
entries.translation: 每个计算器都会在全部六个版本中实际运行，而不只测试英文版，并将答案与预期值核对——核心电压降案例的预期值由手工计算得出，其余案例则从封印数据表中推导。我们曾吃过这个亏：一次只运行英文版的测试显示全部通过，但主计算器在另外四个版本中根本无法使用。
entries.backTranslation: Each calculator is actually run in all six editions, not just tested in English, and its answer is checked against an expected value—the expected values for the core voltage drop cases are calculated by hand, while those for the remaining cases are derived from the sealed data tables. We learned this the hard way: one test run that covered only the English edition showed that everything passed, but the main calculator was completely unusable in four other editions.

entries.original: The numeric-parity check covers the translated guides, the Terms page, and three newer pages, including this one. On those pages, every visible number is compared with its English twin, except for a value explicitly marked as a legitimate locale-specific difference.
entries.translation: 数值一致性检查覆盖已翻译的指南、条款页面以及包括本页在内的三个较新页面。在这些页面上，每个可见数字都会与对应英文页面核对；只有明确标记为合理本地差异的数值例外。
entries.backTranslation: The numerical consistency check covers the translated guides, the Terms page, and three newer pages, including this one. On these pages, every visible number is checked against the corresponding English page; the only exceptions are values explicitly marked as legitimate local differences.

entries.original: So read the labels rather than assuming. Where the data behind a result hasn't passed for your country, the page tells you so in plain language instead of quietly presenting it as a verified answer.
entries.translation: 所以，请先看页面标签，不要想当然。若某个结果背后的数据尚未通过您所在国家的核查，页面会用直白的文字说明，而不会悄悄把它当作已经验证的答案呈现。
entries.backTranslation: So please read the page labels first and do not take anything for granted. If the data behind a result has not yet passed review for your country, the page explains this in plain language instead of quietly presenting it as an already verified answer.

entries.original: Your local inspector (AHJ) decides, not us. Confirm the result against the rules actually adopted in your area before you install anything.
entries.translation: 最终决定权在您当地的检查人员（AHJ），不在我们。安装前，请按您所在地区实际采用的规则核对结果。
entries.backTranslation: The final decision rests with your local inspector (AHJ), not with us. Before installation, check the result against the rules actually adopted in your area.

entries.original: No licensed electrician reviews or approves VoltDrop. Nobody here is holding a licence over this work. If a page ever claims otherwise, it's wrong — tell us.
entries.translation: VoltDrop 没有持证电工进行审查或认可。这里没有任何人以专业执照为这项工作背书。如果页面声称有，那就是错误，请告诉我们。
entries.backTranslation: VoltDrop has no licensed electrician reviewing or endorsing it. No one here backs this work with a professional license. If a page claims otherwise, it is wrong; please tell us.

entries.original: VoltDrop is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or approved by NFPA. No calculator is “NEC certified,” including this one. That isn't a thing.
entries.translation: VoltDrop 与 NFPA 没有隶属关系，也未获得其背书或认可。任何计算器都不存在“NEC 认证”，本页面也不例外。根本没有这种认证。
entries.backTranslation: VoltDrop is not affiliated with NFPA and has not been endorsed or approved by it. There is no “NEC certification” for any calculator, including this page. No such certification exists.

entries.original: The Canadian conduit-fill page shows what happens when a gap closes. It used to carry a warning because its Canadian conductor and conduit tables had not passed the multi-source check. CSA C22.1:24 Tables 6A/6K and 9A–9H have now passed, so the warning is gone and the page computes from sealed Canadian data. We would rather leave a visible gap than fill it early, and remove the warning only when the evidence changes.
entries.translation: 加拿大导管填充页面展示了数据缺口补齐后会发生什么。过去，加拿大导线和导管表格尚未通过多来源核查，因此页面带有警告。现在CSA C22.1:24 Tables 6A/6K和9A–9H已经通过核查，警告已移除，页面也改用封存的加拿大数据计算。我们宁可保留一个看得见的缺口，也不会过早填补；只有证据发生变化时才会移除警告。
entries.backTranslation: The Canadian conduit fill page shows what happens when a data gap is filled. In the past, the page carried a warning because the Canadian conductor and conduit tables had not yet passed the multiple-source check. Now CSA C22.1:24 Tables 6A/6K and 9A–9H have passed the check, the warning has been removed, and the page now calculates using sealed Canadian data. We would rather leave a visible gap than fill it too soon; the warning is removed only when the evidence changes.

entries.original: Results are planning estimates using simplified, normal-conditions methods. Real installations have conditions our inputs don't ask about.
entries.translation: 结果是按正常条件和简化方法得出的规划估算。实际安装中存在一些情况，而我们的输入项并未询问这些情况。
entries.backTranslation: The results are planning estimates derived from normal conditions and simplified methods. Actual installations have conditions that our input fields do not ask about.

entries.original: Terms that must never be translated — code names, wire types, and units — are checked for survival in every language.
entries.translation: 规范名称、导线类型和单位等绝不能翻译的词语，会在每种语言中检查是否原样保留。
entries.backTranslation: In every language, we check that terms which must never be translated, such as code names, conductor types, and units, remain unchanged.

entries.original: The easiest thing in the world would be to fill every gap with a plausible-looking number and say nothing about it. When a country-specific table has not passed, we label the boundary or refuse the answer in the place you would be about to rely on it.
entries.translation: 世界上最容易的做法，是用一个看似合理的数字填满每个空缺，却对此只字不提。当某个国家专用表格尚未通过核查时，我们会在您即将依赖结果的位置标明边界，或拒绝给出答案。
entries.backTranslation: The easiest thing in the world would be to fill every gap with a number that seems plausible and say nothing about it. When a country-specific table has not yet passed the check, we mark the boundary or refuse to provide an answer at the point where you are about to rely on the result.

entries.original: The English pages are compared byte-for-byte against the previous build, so nothing changes by accident.
entries.translation: 英文页面会与上一次生成结果逐字节比较，避免任何意外改动。
entries.backTranslation: The English pages are compared byte for byte with the previous generation to prevent any accidental changes.

entries.original: This is not theatre. One draft ampacity value in an early build disagreed between sources. The check caught it, the value was corrected before it shipped, and that is the whole reason the step exists.
entries.translation: 这不是做样子。早期版本中的一个载流量草案值在不同来源之间不一致。核查发现了问题，并在发布前更正了该数值。这正是设置这一步的原因。
entries.backTranslation: This is not for show. A draft ampacity value in an early version was inconsistent across different sources. The check found the problem, and the value was corrected before publication. That is exactly why this step exists.

entries.original: VoltDrop doesn't type numbers in from memory. Every electrical table built into these calculators is compared against at least two independently produced reproductions of the published table before it goes live, row by row. They all have to agree, on every cell, or it doesn't ship.
entries.translation: VoltDrop 不凭记忆录入数字。每张内置电气数据表在发布前，都要逐行逐格对照至少两份由不同人员独立制作的已发布表格复本。所有复本的每一个单元格都必须一致，否则就不会发布。
entries.backTranslation: VoltDrop does not enter numbers from memory. Before publication, every built-in electrical data table is checked row by row and cell by cell against at least two reproductions of the published table independently produced by different people. Every cell in all reproductions must match, or it is not published.

entries.original: VoltDrop ships in six editions across four languages. A safety warning that quietly loses its meaning in translation is a real hazard, so we screen for it: the translated text is turned back into English on its own, without the original in view, and the result is compared against what we actually meant.
entries.translation: VoltDrop 以四种语言提供六个版本。安全警告在翻译中悄悄失去原意，会造成真实危险。因此我们会进行筛查：在不查看英文原文的情况下，单独把译文回译成英文，再将结果与原本要表达的含义比较。
entries.backTranslation: VoltDrop provides six editions in four languages. A safety warning quietly losing its original meaning in translation creates a real danger. We therefore screen for this: without viewing the original English text, the translated text is independently translated back into English, and the result is compared with the meaning originally intended.

entries.original: We also watch the screen itself. An early version of this check reported almost everything as perfect because the English original had leaked into the process and was simply being echoed back. That run was thrown out. The check was rebuilt so the source is sealed out of it. Runs that show signs of leakage are rejected rather than trusted.
entries.translation: 我们也会检查筛查过程本身。早期版本曾把几乎所有内容都判为完美，原因是英文原文混入了流程，系统只是把原文照样返回。那次结果被全部作废。之后我们重建了流程，把原文严格隔离在外。只要发现原文泄漏的迹象，该次结果就会被拒绝，而不会被采信。
entries.backTranslation: We also check the screening process itself. An early version once judged almost everything perfect because the original English text had entered the process and the system simply returned it unchanged. All results from that run were invalidated. We then rebuilt the process to keep the original text strictly isolated. If any sign of original-text leakage is found, the run is rejected rather than accepted.

entries.original: We've tested that the seal fires on a one-digit edit.
entries.translation: 我们已经测试确认：只改动一个数字也会触发封印。
entries.backTranslation: We have tested and confirmed that changing even one number triggers the seal.

entries.original: You're about to size a conductor from a number on a screen. Here's exactly where that number came from, and what we do to stop it being wrong.
entries.translation: 您即将根据屏幕上的一个数字选择导线规格。这里会准确说明该数字从何而来，以及我们如何尽力阻止错误数字出现。
entries.backTranslation: You are about to choose a conductor size based on a number on the screen. Here we explain exactly where that number came from and how we try to prevent an incorrect number from appearing.

entries.original: Ohm's law describes a circuit; it does not size a conductor. Wire size depends on ampacity (heat) and voltage drop (distance), neither of which is in this equation. For those, use
entries.translation: 欧姆定律描述回路，但不能确定导线线径。线径取决于载流量（发热）和电压降（距离），而这两项都不在该方程中。请使用
entries.backTranslation: Ohm’s law describes a circuit, but it cannot determine conductor size. Conductor size depends on ampacity (heat) and voltage drop (distance), and neither is in this equation. Please use

entries.original: Ask for ohms on a three-phase circuit and this calculator declines, on purpose. A single resistance figure depends on whether the load is wye or delta connected, and that changes the answer. This form does not ask, and many people wiring a motor do not know off the top of their head. Printing a number anyway would be a guess dressed up as a result.
entries.translation: 如果要求计算三相回路的欧姆数，本计算器会有意拒绝。单一电阻值取决于负载采用星形还是三角形连接，两者会改变答案。此表单没有询问该信息，而许多为电机接线的人也未必能立即确定。仍然给出数字，只是把猜测伪装成结果。
entries.backTranslation: If asked to calculate ohms for a three-phase circuit, this calculator deliberately refuses. A single resistance value depends on whether the load uses a star or delta connection, and the two produce different answers. This form does not ask for that information, and many people wiring a motor may not be able to determine it immediately. Providing a number anyway would merely disguise a guess as a result.

entries.original: Free NEC ampacity derating calculator for ambient temperature, current-carrying conductors, termination limits, 240.4(D), and separate continuous-load sizing.
entries.translation: 免费的NEC载流量降容计算器，涵盖环境温度、载流导体数量、端子限值、240.4(D)，并单独计算连续负载容量。
entries.backTranslation: Free NEC ampacity derating calculator covering ambient temperature, number of current-carrying conductors, terminal limits, 240.4(D), and calculating continuous load capacity separately.

entries.original: VoltDrop Ampacity Derating Check
entries.translation: VoltDrop载流量降容检查
entries.backTranslation: VoltDrop ampacity derating check

entries.original: Ampacity Derating Calculator — NEC 310.15 | VoltDrop
entries.translation: 载流量降容计算器 — NEC 310.15 | VoltDrop
entries.backTranslation: Ampacity Derating Calculator — NEC 310.15 | VoltDrop

entries.original: Free NEC 314.16 box fill calculator: count wires, devices, grounds and clamps, get a clear fits/too-full verdict with the cubic-inch math shown. No signup.
entries.translation: 基于NEC 314.16的免费接线盒填充计算器：计算导线、器件、接地导体和电缆夹，并显示明确结果和容积计算。
entries.backTranslation: Free junction-box-fill calculator based on NEC 314.16: count wires, devices, grounding conductors, and cable clamps, and display a clear result and volume calculation.

entries.original: Free conduit fill calculator: THHN wire count and size in, smallest legal EMT or PVC Schedule 40 conduit out — using the official NEC Chapter 9 tables and 53/31/40% fill limits.
entries.translation: 免费导管填充计算器：输入THHN导线数量和规格，根据NEC Chapter 9及53/31/40%限值查找最小合规EMT或PVC Schedule 40规格。
entries.backTranslation: Free conduit-fill calculator: enter the quantity and size of THHN wires and find the smallest compliant EMT or PVC Schedule 40 size according to NEC Chapter 9 and the 53/31/40% limits.

entries.original: Verified distance tables for 14-6 AWG at 120 V and 240 V under the 3% voltage-drop target — plus why other sites say 50, 57, or 100 feet for the same wire.
entries.translation: 14-6 AWG 在 120 V 和 240 V、3% 电压降目标下的已验证距离表 —— 外加为什么别的网站对同一根线说 50、57 或 100 英尺。
entries.backTranslation: Verified distance tables for 14-6 AWG at 120 V and 240 V with a 3% voltage drop target — plus why other sites say 50, 57, or 100 feet for the same wire.

entries.original: Ten verified NEC and Canadian Electrical Code differences: ampacity, derating, continuous loads, voltage drop, conduit fill, conductor colours, and the high leg.
entries.translation: 十项经核实的 NEC 与 Canadian Electrical Code 差异：载流量、降额、连续负载、电压降、导管填充、导线颜色和高脚。
entries.backTranslation: Ten verified differences between the NEC and the Canadian Electrical Code: ampacity, adjustment, continuous loads, voltage drop, conduit fill, conductor colours, and the high leg.

entries.original: NEC vs CEC — 10 Electrical Code Differences That Change the Answer | VoltDrop
entries.translation: NEC 与 CEC — 会改变答案的 10 项电气规范差异 | VoltDrop
entries.backTranslation: NEC vs CEC — 10 electrical-code differences that change the answer | VoltDrop

entries.original: Free max wire run calculator: enter wire size, amps, and voltage to get the longest one-way distance that stays under 3% or 5% voltage drop. Copper and aluminum, DC and AC, no signup.
entries.translation: 免费导线最大长度计算器：输入导线规格（线规）、安培和电压，即可获得能使电压降保持在3%或5%限值内的最大单程距离（仅去程）。
entries.backTranslation: Free maximum-wire-length calculator: enter conductor size (wire gauge), amperes, and voltage to obtain the maximum one-way distance (outbound only) that keeps voltage drop within the 3% or 5% limit.

entries.original: How far can your wire run before voltage drop becomes a problem? Get the maximum one-way distance for any wire size and load.
entries.translation: 在电压降产生问题之前，导线最长可以敷设多远？针对任何导线规格（线规）和负载计算最大单程距离（仅去程）。
entries.backTranslation: How far at most can the conductor be run before voltage drop creates a problem? Calculate the maximum one-way distance (outbound only) for any conductor size (wire gauge) and load.

entries.original: Free NEC conductor size calculator for ampacity and voltage drop. See the heat-driven minimum, distance-driven minimum, governing AWG, and separate margins.
entries.translation: 免费的 NEC 导线规格计算器，同时检查载流量与电压降，并显示热量最小规格、距离最小规格、最终 AWG 及各自余量。
entries.backTranslation: Free NEC conductor size calculator that checks both ampacity and voltage drop and shows the minimum size for heat, the minimum size for distance, the final AWG, and their respective margins.

entries.original: Ohms modes are unavailable for three-phase. The answer changes depending on whether the load is wye or delta connected, and this calculator does not ask for that.
entries.translation: 三相系统不能使用欧姆模式。负载采用星形连接还是三角形连接会改变答案，而本计算器未询问该信息。
entries.backTranslation: Ohms mode cannot be used for three-phase systems. Whether the load uses a star or delta connection changes the answer, and this calculator does not ask for that information.

entries.original: Watts (kW) measure real usable power, while kVA measures the apparent power the wiring must carry. For heaters and simple loads they are equal; for motors and electronics kVA can be higher, and the ratio between them is the power factor.
entries.translation: 瓦特（kW）表示实际可用功率，kVA表示导线必须承载的视在功率。对于加热器和简单负载，两者相等；对于电动机和电子设备，kVA可能更高。两者之比就是功率因数。
entries.backTranslation: Watts (kW) represent actual usable power, while kVA represents the apparent power that the wire must carry. For heaters and simple loads, the two are equal; for motors and electronic equipment, kVA may be higher. The ratio between the two is the power factor.

entries.original: The calculators run entirely in your browser — the numbers you type never leave your device. We don't require accounts, we don't sell data, and the only personal information we ever hold is what you give us if you choose to sign in and leave a comment.
entries.translation: 计算器完全在您的浏览器中运行，您输入的数字绝不会离开设备。我们不要求注册、不出售数据；只有当您选择登录并发表评论时，我们才会保存您主动提供的个人信息。
entries.backTranslation: The calculators run entirely in your browser, and the numbers you enter never leave the device. We do not require registration and do not sell data; we save personal information that you voluntarily provide only when you choose to sign in and post a comment.

entries.original: We don't sell or share your personal information with advertisers or data brokers. We don't send marketing email. We don't track you across other websites.
entries.translation: 我们不会向广告商或数据经纪人出售或分享您的个人信息。我们不发送营销邮件，也不会跨网站跟踪您。
entries.backTranslation: We do not sell or share your personal information with advertisers or data brokers. We do not send marketing emails, and we do not track you across websites.

entries.original: we use Google Analytics to understand overall traffic (pages visited, general region, device type). This is standard aggregate analytics; we don't use it to identify you.
entries.translation: 我们使用Google Analytics了解总体流量（访问页面、大致地区和设备类型）。这些是汇总分析数据，不用于识别您的身份。
entries.backTranslation: We use Google Analytics to understand overall traffic (pages visited, approximate region, and device type). These are aggregated analytics data and are not used to identify you.

entries.original: What we don't do
entries.translation: 我们不做什么
entries.backTranslation: What we do not do

entries.original: Canadian counting (Rule 12-3034): each insulated wire entering the box counts once at its own size. Bare bond wires are NOT counted. Each device counts twice. Every PAIR of insulated wire connectors (marrettes) counts once. Devices and marrette pairs use the largest listed conductor. Cable clamps get NO allowance in Canada. Pigtails that live entirely inside the box are free.
entries.translation: 加拿大计数规则（Rule 12-3034）：每根进入接线盒的绝缘导线按自身规格计一次。裸露的接地跨接导线不计。每个器件计两次。每对绝缘导线连接器（marrettes）计一次。器件和marrettes对均按列出的最大导线计算。加拿大不计电缆夹。完全留在接线盒内的引线不计。
entries.backTranslation: Canadian counting (Rule 12-3034): each insulated conductor entering the box counts once at its own size. Bare bonding conductors do NOT count. Each device counts twice. Each PAIR of insulated connectors (marrettes) counts once. Devices and marrette pairs use the largest listed conductor. Clamps receive NO volume in Canada. Internal pigtails do not count.

entries.original: Canadian fine print: bare bond wires and cable clamps get no allowance (unlike the US); marrettes count one allowance per pair, sized by the largest wire in them (we use your selected size — pick the largest present to be safe); devices deeper than 2.54 cm need an extra deduction of 32 mL per cm of depth, which this simple check doesn't include.
entries.translation: 加拿大细则：裸露的接地跨接导体和电缆夹不预留容积；每对marrettes按其中最大的导线预留容积（本工具使用您选择的导线规格；为确保安全，请选择盒内尺寸最大的导线）。器件深度超过2.54 cm时，每cm还需扣除32 mL，本简化检查不包括这项扣除。
entries.backTranslation: Canadian details: bare bonding conductors and cable clamps do not reserve volume; each pair of marrettes reserves volume according to the largest wire among them (this tool uses the conductor size you selected; to ensure safety, choose the largest-sized conductor in the box). When a device is more than 2.54 cm deep, an additional 32 mL per cm must be deducted; this simplified check does not include that deduction.

entries.original: Cram too many wires into a box and connections get stressed, insulation gets nicked, and heat builds up — a classic cause of failed inspections and flickering circuits. The U.S. electrical code (NEC 314.16) assigns every wire a space allowance based on its size, and the box must have at least that much room.
entries.translation: 接线盒过满会使连接点受力、损伤绝缘层并积聚热量，常导致检查不合格和电路闪断。NEC 314.16按导线规格（线规）规定所需空间，接线盒必须至少提供该容积。
entries.backTranslation: An overfilled junction box puts stress on connections, damages insulation, and accumulates heat, often causing failed inspections and intermittent circuit interruptions. NEC 314.16 specifies the required space by conductor size (wire gauge), and the junction box must provide at least that volume.

entries.original: Cram too many wires into a box and connections get stressed, insulation gets nicked, and heat builds up — a classic cause of failed inspections. The Canadian Electrical Code (Rule 12-3034 with Table 22) assigns every insulated wire a space allowance in millilitres, and the box must have at least that much room.
entries.translation: 接线盒过满会使连接点受力、损伤绝缘层并积聚热量，常导致检查不合格。Canadian Electrical Code（Rule 12-3034和Table 22）按毫升为每根绝缘导线规定空间，接线盒必须至少提供该容积。
entries.backTranslation: An overfilled junction box puts stress on connections, damages insulation, and accumulates heat, often causing failed inspections. Canadian Electrical Code (Rule 12-3034 and Table 22) specifies space in millilitres for each insulated wire, and the junction box must provide at least that volume.

entries.original: Each hot or neutral entering the box counts at its own size — including wires that pass straight through unbroken. Each device (switch/outlet) counts twice at the allowance of its largest connected conductor. All ground wires together count once at the largest ground size. Built-in cable clamps count once at the largest conductor in the box. Pigtails that live entirely inside the box are free.
entries.translation: 每根进入接线盒的相线或中性线都按其自身规格计算，包括未断开而穿过接线盒的导线。每个器件按其连接的最大导线容积计两次。所有接地导线合计一次，按最大接地导线计算。内部电缆夹按接线盒内最大导线计一次。完全留在接线盒内的引线不计。
entries.backTranslation: Each hot or neutral conductor entering the box counts at its own size, including conductors that pass through unbroken. Each device counts twice using the volume of its largest connected conductor. All grounds together count once using the largest ground. Internal clamps count once using the largest conductor in the box. Internal pigtails do not count.

entries.original: Fine print: pigtails that stay entirely inside the box don't count, but a wire passing through unbroken DOES count once — include it above. If more than four ground wires enter the box, each one beyond four adds a ¼ count (2020 code rule) — add roughly one extra wire to be safe. Mixed wire sizes deserve the full by-size calculation (coming soon); until then, picking your largest size is the safe way to use this tool.
entries.translation: 细则：始终留在盒内的引出短线不计，但未断开而穿过接线盒的导线必须计一次。接地导体超过四根时，根据2020规则，每增加一根加¼。如果有多个规格，请选择最大的导线规格（线规）以保留安全余量。
entries.backTranslation: Details: pigtails that remain entirely inside the box do not count, but a conductor that passes through the junction box uncut must be counted once. When there are more than four grounding conductors, each additional one adds ¼ under the 2020 rules. If there are multiple sizes, choose the largest conductor size (wire gauge) to preserve a safety margin.

entries.original: Smallest-size proof: {size} passes and is the smallest size this ampacity table supports for {material}. The engine makes no claim about smaller sizes.

entries.backTranslation: Minimum-size proof: {size} passes and is the smallest {material} size supported by this ampacity table. The calculation engine makes no determination about smaller sizes.

entries.original: Distance did not raise the conductor — zero listed sizes. Ampacity raised it from the distance-only {dropSize} to {finalSize}.
entries.translation: 距离没有提高导线规格：移动零个已列规格。载流量要求把仅按距离可用的 {dropSize} 增大到 {finalSize}。
entries.backTranslation: Distance did not increase the conductor size: zero listed-size moves. The ampacity requirement increases {dropSize}, which is permitted by distance alone, to {finalSize}.

entries.original: Smallest-size proof: {size} passes. The next smaller supported size, {smallerSize}, fails the entered {load} A under the applied load rule.
entries.translation: 最小规格证明：{size} 通过。下一个更小的受支持规格 {smallerSize} 在所应用的负载规则下不能通过输入的 {load} A。
entries.backTranslation: Minimum-size proof: {size} passes. The next smaller supported size, {smallerSize}, cannot pass the entered {load} A under the applied load rule.

entries.original: Distance did not raise the conductor beyond ampacity — zero listed sizes. Both constraints select {finalSize}; this is a normal tie.
entries.translation: 距离没有把导线提高到载流量要求以上：移动零个已列规格。两项约束都选择 {finalSize}；这是正常的相同结果。
entries.backTranslation: Distance did not increase the conductor beyond the ampacity requirement: zero listed-size moves. Both constraints select {finalSize}; this is a normal identical result.

entries.original:
Continuous-load step

Entered load: {load} A × {factor}% = {after} A required ampacity {after} A ≤ {permitted} A permitted ampacity → passes

The switch treats the entire entered load as continuous; it does not model a mixed load.
entries.translation:
连续负载步骤

输入负载：{load} A × {factor}% = {after} A 所需载流量 {after} A ≤ {permitted} A 允许载流量 → 通过

此开关将全部输入负载视为连续负载；不计算混合负载。
entries.backTranslation:
Continuous-load step

Entered load: {load} A × {factor}% = {after} A required ampacity {after} A ≤ {permitted} A permitted ampacity → pass

This switch treats the entire entered load as continuous; it does not calculate a mixed load.

entries.original: NEC continuous load: 125% of the load. Before: {load} A entered load. After: {load} A × {factor}% = {after} A required ampacity. The switch treats the entire entered load as continuous; it does not model a mixed load.
entries.translation: NEC 连续负载：按负载的 125% 计算。调整前：输入负载为 {load} A。调整后：{load} A × {factor}% = {after} A 所需载流量。此开关将全部输入负载视为连续负载；不计算混合负载。
entries.backTranslation: NEC continuous load: calculated at 125% of the load. Before adjustment: entered load is {load} A. After adjustment: {load} A × {factor}% = {after} A required ampacity. This switch treats the entire entered load as continuous; it does not calculate a mixed load.

entries.original: At exactly this distance you hit {percent}% drop. Stay shorter for margin. And remember: the wire must also be rated for {amps} A (ampacity) regardless of distance.
entries.translation: 在此距离下，电压降正好达到{percent}%。请缩短线路以保留余量。还要注意：无论距离多短，导线都必须具有承载{amps} A的额定载流量。
entries.backTranslation: At this distance, voltage drop is exactly {percent}%. Shorten the run to retain margin. Regardless of distance, the conductor must have an ampacity rating sufficient for {amps} A.

entries.original:
We rearranged the formula to solve for distance, with your limit of {percent}% ({maxDrop} V):

Max one-way feet = {maxDrop} V × {cm} cmil ÷ ({mult} × {factor} × {amps} A) = {feet} ft
entries.translation:
根据您的{percent}%限值（{maxDrop} V），我们将公式变形以求解距离：

最大单程英尺 = {maxDrop} V × {cm} cmil ÷（{mult} × {factor} × {amps} A） = {feet} ft
entries.backTranslation:
Using your {percent}% limit ({maxDrop} V), the formula is rearranged to solve for distance:

Maximum one-way feet = {maxDrop} V × {cm} cmil ÷ ({mult} × {factor} × {amps} A) = {feet} ft

entries.original: no listed size keeps you under {percent}%
entries.translation: 没有任何所列规格可将电压降控制在{percent}%以下
entries.backTranslation: none of the listed gauges keeps voltage drop below {percent}%

entries.original: Even {size} {material} drops more than {percent}% over {feet} one-way feet at {amps} A.
entries.translation: 即使使用{size} {material}线，在{feet}英尺单程距离（仅去程）和{amps} A条件下，电压降仍超过{percent}%。
entries.backTranslation: Even with {size} {material} conductor over {feet} one-way feet at {amps} A, voltage drop remains above {percent}%.

entries.original: The published ambient table marks {ambient}°C with {insulation}°C insulation as “—” or outside the supported rows. No correction factor is substituted and no conductor size is returned.
entries.translation: 已发布的环境温度表将 {ambient}°C 环境温度与 {insulation}°C 绝缘组合标为“—”，或该组合超出支持的表格行。本工具不会替代校正系数，也不会返回导线规格。
entries.backTranslation: The published ambient-temperature table marks the combination of {ambient}°C ambient temperature and {insulation}°C insulation as “—”, or the combination is outside the supported table rows. This tool does not substitute a correction factor or return a conductor size.

entries.original: Refusal: {constraint} did not produce a passing listed size. The largest listed conductor is not returned as a recommendation.
entries.translation: 拒绝给出规格：{constraint}未找到合格的列出规格。本工具不会把最大的列出导线作为建议返回。
entries.backTranslation: Size rejected: {constraint} did not find a qualifying listed size. This tool does not return the largest listed conductor as a recommendation.

entries.original: No listed conductor passes both checks. The voltage-drop search found {dropStatus}; the ampacity search found {ampacityStatus}. Change the design or have a qualified electrician evaluate conductors or arrangements outside this tool.
entries.translation: 没有任何列出的导线能同时通过两项检查。电压降搜索得到：{dropStatus}；载流量搜索得到：{ampacityStatus}。请更改设计，或由合格电工评估本工具范围以外的导线或布置。
entries.backTranslation: No listed conductor can pass both checks. The voltage-drop search returned: {dropStatus}; the ampacity search returned: {ampacityStatus}. Change the design or have a qualified electrician evaluate conductors or arrangements outside this tool's scope.

entries.original:
We tested each size, smallest first, until one kept the drop under your {percent}% limit ({maxDrop} V):

{size} ({cm} cmil): {mult} × {factor} × {amps} A × {feet} ft ÷ {cm} = {dropped} V = {actualPercent}% ✓ under your limit
entries.translation:
我们从最小规格开始逐一检查，直到找到可将电压降控制在{percent}%限值（{maxDrop} V）以下的规格：

{size}（{cm} cmil）： {mult} × {factor} × {amps} A × {feet} ft ÷ {cm} = {dropped} V = {actualPercent}% ✓ 低于您的限值
entries.backTranslation:
Starting at the smallest gauge, each was checked until one kept voltage drop below the {percent}% limit ({maxDrop} V):

{size} ({cm} cmil): {mult} × {factor} × {amps} A × {feet} ft ÷ {cm} = {dropped} V = {actualPercent}% ✓ below your limit

entries.original: smallest {material} wire that stays under {percent}%
entries.translation: 可将电压降控制在{percent}%以下的最小{material}线规格
entries.backTranslation: smallest {material} conductor gauge that keeps voltage drop below {percent}%

entries.original: This sizes wire for voltage drop. The conductor also has to be rated to carry the current without overheating, which is a different calculation with different tables. Outdoors, in conduit, and in sunlight, derating matters. Check it:
entries.translation: 本工具按电压降确定导线线径。导线还必须能够承载电流而不过热，这是使用不同表格的另一项计算。户外、导管内和阳光下安装时，降额非常重要。请检查：
entries.backTranslation: This tool determines conductor size by voltage drop. The conductor must also be able to carry the current without overheating, which is another calculation using different tables. Derating is very important when installing outdoors, inside a conduit, and in sunlight. Check:

entries.original: The drop targets this tool uses are starting points from common solar practice, not code requirements. There is no code rule that says 2%. Your equipment manufacturer may specify something tighter, and their number wins. The tool shows the target it used so you can change it knowingly rather than inherit it silently.
entries.translation: 本工具采用的电压降目标是常见光伏实践中的起点，不是规范要求。没有任何规范规定必须是 2%。设备制造商可能要求更严格的数值，应以制造商要求为准。工具会显示所采用的目标，让您在了解情况后主动修改，而不是在不知情时默认继承。
entries.backTranslation: The voltage-drop targets used by this tool are starting points from common solar practice, not code requirements. No code requires 2%. The equipment manufacturer may require a stricter value, in which case the manufacturer’s requirement takes precedence. The tool displays the target being used so that you can actively change it with an understanding of the situation instead of unknowingly inheriting the default.

entries.original: Always verify calculations independently, follow your local electrical code and permit requirements, and hire a licensed professional where required by law or common sense.
entries.translation: 请务必独立核验计算，遵守当地电气规范和许可要求，并在法律或安全常识要求时聘请持证专业人员。
entries.backTranslation: Be sure to verify calculations independently, comply with local electrical codes and permit requirements, and hire a licensed professional when required by law or common sense about safety.

entries.original: Don't attack, overload, scrape at abusive rates, reverse-engineer for the purpose of harming, or otherwise interfere with the Service, and don't use it in violation of any law.
entries.translation: 不得攻击服务、使其过载、以滥用频率抓取内容、为造成损害而进行逆向工程，或以其他方式干扰服务；也不得违法使用服务。
entries.backTranslation: Do not attack the Service, overload it, scrape content at an abusive rate, reverse engineer it for the purpose of causing harm, or otherwise interfere with the Service; also do not use the Service unlawfully.

entries.original: Electrical work can injure or kill, and mistakes can cause fires.
entries.translation: 电气作业可能造成伤亡，错误还可能引发火灾。
entries.backTranslation: Electrical work may cause injury or death, and errors may also cause fires.

entries.original: For Canadian code-based calculations, VoltDrop implements CSA C22.1:24 — Canadian Electrical Code, Part I, 26th edition (2024): Tables 2, 4, 5A, 5C, and 22, and Rules 4-004, 4-006, 8-102, 8-104, 12-3034, and 14-104.
entries.translation: 对于基于加拿大规范的计算，VoltDrop实施CSA C22.1:24 — Canadian Electrical Code, Part I, 26th edition (2024)：Tables 2、4、5A、5C和22，以及Rules 4-004、4-006、8-102、8-104、12-3034和14-104。
entries.backTranslation: For calculations based on Canadian codes, VoltDrop implements CSA C22.1:24 — Canadian Electrical Code, Part I, 26th edition (2024): Tables 2, 4, 5A, 5C, and 22, as well as Rules 4-004, 4-006, 8-102, 8-104, 12-3034, and 14-104.

entries.original: For U.S. code-based calculations, VoltDrop implements the 2023 edition of NFPA 70 — National Electrical Code (NEC): Table 310.16, Tables 310.15(B)(1) and 310.15(C)(1), 240.4(D), and 110.14(C). Its conduit-fill and box-fill tools also use NEC Chapter 9 Tables 4 and 5 and NEC 314.16, including Tables 314.16(A) and 314.16(B).
entries.translation: 对于基于美国规范的计算，VoltDrop实施2023版NFPA 70 — National Electrical Code (NEC)：Table 310.16、Tables 310.15(B)(1)和310.15(C)(1)、240.4(D)以及110.14(C)。导管填充和接线盒填充工具还使用NEC Chapter 9 Tables 4和5以及NEC 314.16，包括Tables 314.16(A)和314.16(B)。
entries.backTranslation: For calculations based on U.S. codes, VoltDrop implements the 2023 edition of NFPA 70 — National Electrical Code (NEC): Table 310.16, Tables 310.15(B)(1) and 310.15(C)(1), 240.4(D), and 110.14(C). The conduit-fill and box-fill tools also use NEC Chapter 9 Tables 4 and 5 and NEC 314.16, including Tables 314.16(A) and 314.16(B).

entries.original: . If you don't agree, please don't use the Service.
entries.translation: 。如果您不同意，请勿使用本服务。
entries.backTranslation: . If you do not agree, do not use this Service.

entries.original: Results are simplified estimates for normal conditions. They do not account for every real-world factor (temperature, bundling, derating, continuous loads, local code amendments, equipment listings, and more). The Service is not a substitute for a licensed electrician or professional engineer, and using it does not create any professional relationship.
entries.translation: 结果是正常条件下的简化估算，并未涵盖所有实际因素，例如温度、成束敷设、降容、连续负载、当地规范修订和设备认证等。本服务不能替代持证电工或专业工程师，使用本服务也不会形成任何专业关系。
entries.backTranslation: The results are simplified estimates under normal conditions and do not cover all real-world factors, such as temperature, bundled installation, derating, continuous loads, local code revisions, and equipment certification. This Service cannot replace a licensed electrician or professional engineer, and use of this Service does not form any professional relationship.

entries.original: States, provinces, and municipalities adopt codes on different schedules and may add local amendments. A result that is correct under the edition VoltDrop implements can be wrong where an earlier edition or local amendment applies. You must confirm the edition adopted by your own authority.
entries.translation: 各州、各省和各市采用规范的时间表不同，并可能加入当地修订。按照VoltDrop所实施版本得出的正确结果，在适用较早版本或当地修订的地区可能是错误的。您必须确认您所在地区的主管机构所采用的版本。
entries.backTranslation: States, provinces, and municipalities adopt codes on different schedules and may add local amendments. A result that is correct under the edition implemented by VoltDrop may be wrong in a place where an earlier edition or a local amendment applies. You must confirm the edition adopted by the authority in your area.

If liability cannot be fully excluded, our total liability is limited to $50 (USD). Some jurisdictions don't allow certain exclusions, so parts of this may not apply to you.
entries.translation: 在法律允许的最大范围内，VoltDrop及其运营者不对您使用或无法使用本服务造成的任何损害负责，包括财产损失、人身伤害、利润损失或返工费用，无论责任依据是保证、合同、侵权还是其他理论。如果责任无法完全排除，我们的总责任以$50 (USD)为限。某些地区不允许特定免责条款，因此部分内容可能不适用于您。
entries.backTranslation: To the maximum extent permitted by law, VoltDrop and its operator are not responsible for any damage caused by your use of or inability to use this Service, including property loss, personal injury, lost profits, or rework costs, whether liability is based on warranty, contract, tort, or another theory. If liability cannot be fully excluded, our total liability is limited to $50 (USD). Some regions do not allow specific disclaimers, so some content may not apply to you.

entries.original: Translations are provided for convenience. If a translated version is inconsistent with the English version, the English version governs.
entries.translation: 翻译版本仅为方便阅读而提供。如果翻译版本与英文版本不一致，以英文版本为准。
entries.backTranslation: Translated versions are provided only for ease of reading. If a translated version is inconsistent with the English version, the English version controls.

entries.original: VoltDrop sometimes uses a simplified or conservative method. For example, CEC Rule 4-006 limits the termination-temperature requirement to the first 1.2 m of conductor and permits a compliant transition beyond it. VoltDrop does not model that split; it applies the lower of the conductor and termination temperature ratings to the entire run. This is conservative, but it is not the full Code procedure.
entries.translation: VoltDrop有时采用简化或保守的方法。例如，CEC Rule 4-006将端接温度要求限制在导体起始的前1.2 m，并允许在其后进行符合规范的转换。VoltDrop不对这一分段建模，而是在全长范围内采用导体与端接温度额定值中的较低者。这种方法较为保守，但并不是规范的完整程序。
entries.backTranslation: VoltDrop sometimes uses a simplified or conservative method. For example, CEC Rule 4-006 limits the termination-temperature requirement to the first 1.2 m from the start of the conductor and permits a code-compliant transition afterward. VoltDrop does not model this split; it uses the lower of the conductor and termination temperature ratings across the full length. This method is conservative, but it is not the code’s complete procedure.

entries.original: Where a Code does not expressly answer an implementation detail, VoltDrop may make a conservative choice that your local inspector or authority may not share. For example, CEC Rule 4-004 does not expressly address installed spare power or lighting conductors; VoltDrop counts them toward Table 5C.
entries.translation: 如果规范没有明确规定某项实施细节，VoltDrop可能会作出保守选择，而您的当地检查员或主管机构可能持不同意见。例如，CEC Rule 4-004没有明确说明已安装的备用功率或照明导体；VoltDrop会将其计入Table 5C。
entries.backTranslation: If a code does not expressly specify an implementation detail, VoltDrop may make a conservative choice with which your local inspector or authority may disagree. For example, CEC Rule 4-004 does not expressly specify installed spare power or lighting conductors; VoltDrop counts them toward Table 5C.

entries.original: You can sign in with Google or Facebook to leave comments. You keep ownership of what you write, but you grant us a worldwide, royalty-free license to display it on the Service. Don't post anything unlawful, hateful, harassing, deceptive, or spammy; no links; no personal information about others; no impersonation. We may remove any comment or suspend commenting access at our discretion, with or without notice. Comment content is other users' opinion, not ours — and comments are never a source of professional electrical advice.
entries.translation: 您可以使用Google或Facebook登录并发表评论。您保留所写内容的所有权，但授予我们在服务中展示该内容的全球性、免版税许可。请勿发布违法、仇恨、骚扰、欺骗或垃圾内容；请勿发布链接、他人个人信息或冒充他人。我们可以自行决定删除评论或暂停评论权限，无论是否另行通知。评论仅代表其他用户的意见，并非我们的意见，也绝不是专业电气建议的来源。
entries.backTranslation: You may sign in with Google or Facebook and post comments. You retain ownership of what you write, but grant us a worldwide, royalty-free license to display that content in the Service. Do not post illegal, hateful, harassing, deceptive, or spam content; do not post links, other people's personal information, or impersonate others. We may decide at our sole discretion to remove comments or suspend commenting privileges, with or without separate notice. Comments represent only the opinions of other users, not ours, and are never a source of professional electrical advice.

entries.original: Green, green with yellow stripes, or bare, under NEC 250.119.
entries.translation: 根据 NEC 250.119，使用绿色、绿色带黄色条纹或裸线。
entries.backTranslation: Use green, green with yellow stripes, or a bare conductor, in accordance with NEC 250.119.

entries.original: Use green, green with yellow stripes, or bare. Conductors 4 AWG and larger may be permanently reidentified at accessible points.
entries.translation: 使用绿色、绿色带黄色条纹或裸线。4 AWG 及更大导线可在可接近位置永久重新标识。
entries.backTranslation: Use green, green with yellow stripes, or a bare conductor. Conductors 4 AWG and larger may be permanently reidentified at accessible locations.

entries.original: On a standard three-phase panelboard, circuits 1 and 2 are phase A, 3 and 4 are B, 5 and 6 are C, then the pattern repeats.
entries.translation: 在标准三相配电盘中，回路 1 和 2 为 A 相，3 和 4 为 B 相，5 和 6 为 C 相，之后重复。
entries.backTranslation: In a standard three-phase panel, circuits 1 and 2 are phase A, 3 and 4 are phase B, 5 and 6 are phase C, and then the pattern repeats.

entries.original: Use this for new work; the actual bus is a meter question. Verify with a meter before touching anything.
entries.translation: 仅用于新安装；实际母排要用仪表确认。触碰任何导线之前，请先用仪表核实。
entries.backTranslation: For new installations only; confirm the actual bus with a meter. Verify with a meter before touching any conductor.

entries.original: NEC 200.6 controls neutral identification and 250.119 controls equipment grounding. For ordinary ungrounded phases, the NEC prohibits reserved colours but does not mandate black/red/blue or brown/orange/yellow; those are trade convention and job-spec choices.
entries.translation: NEC 200.6 规定中性线识别，250.119 规定设备接地线。对于普通非接地相线，NEC 禁止使用保留颜色，但并不强制黑/红/蓝或棕/橙/黄；这些是行业和工程规范的选择。
entries.backTranslation: NEC 200.6 governs neutral identification, and 250.119 governs equipment grounding conductors. For ordinary ungrounded phase conductors, the NEC prohibits reserved colors but does not require black/red/blue or brown/orange/yellow; these are trade and engineering-specification choices.

entries.original: The NEC reserves white, grey and green but does not assign colours to ordinary ungrounded phases. The phase colours shown here are trade convention; the job spec or local practice wins.
entries.translation: NEC 保留白色、灰色和绿色，但不为普通非接地相线指定颜色。这里显示的相线颜色属于行业惯例；工程规范或当地惯例优先。
entries.backTranslation: The NEC reserves white, gray, and green but does not specify colors for ordinary ungrounded phase conductors. The phase-conductor colors shown here are trade practice; the engineering specification or local practice takes precedence.

entries.original: No. Colour tells you what should be installed; it does not prove what an existing conductor is.
entries.translation: 不能。颜色说明应该安装什么，但不能证明现有导线的实际用途。
entries.backTranslation: No. Color indicates what should be installed, but it cannot prove the actual use of an existing conductor.

entries.original: The NEC puts the high leg on phase B, the centre bus. It is orange or identified by another effective means. Canada puts it on phase A.
entries.translation: NEC 把高脚放在 B 相，也就是中间母排。它采用橙色或其他有效识别方式。加拿大则放在 A 相。
entries.backTranslation: The NEC places the high leg on phase B, which is the center bus. It uses orange or another effective means of identification. Canada places it on phase A.

entries.original: In a U.S. 4-wire delta panel, the high leg terminates on phase B and is orange, or identified by another effective means. Canada puts the high leg on phase A.
entries.translation: 在美国4线三角形配电盘中，高脚接在 B 相，并采用橙色或其他有效识别方式。加拿大把高脚放在 A 相。
entries.backTranslation: In a U.S. 4-wire delta panel, the high leg connects to phase B and uses orange or another effective means of identification. Canada places the high leg on phase A.

entries.original: The high leg is on phase B and uses orange, or another effective means of identification.
entries.translation: 高脚位于 B 相，并采用橙色或其他有效识别方式。
entries.backTranslation: The high leg is on phase B and uses orange or another effective means of identification.

entries.original: This tool answers what to install on new work. Legacy wiring, faded insulation and earlier mistakes make colour unreliable as an identification method.
entries.translation: 本工具说明新安装应采用什么颜色。旧线路、褪色绝缘层和既往错误都会使颜色不适合作为识别方法。
entries.backTranslation: This tool indicates which color should be used for a new installation. Old wiring, faded insulation, and past errors make color unsuitable as a means of identification.

entries.original: Enter a whole circuit number of 1 or higher.
entries.translation: 请输入不小于 1 的整数回路编号。
entries.backTranslation: Enter a whole-number circuit number no less than 1.

entries.original: White or grey, or three continuous white or grey stripes, under NEC 200.6.
entries.translation: 根据 NEC 200.6，使用白色或灰色，或三条连续的白色或灰色条纹。
entries.backTranslation: Use white or gray, or three continuous white or gray stripes, in accordance with NEC 200.6.

entries.original: White or grey is required; three continuous white or grey stripes are another permitted identification.
entries.translation: 必须采用白色或灰色；三条连续的白色或灰色条纹也是允许的识别方式。
entries.backTranslation: White or gray must be used; three continuous white or gray stripes are also a permitted means of identification.

entries.original: Count insulated power and lighting conductors. A bonding conductor never counts. Do not count control or signal conductors, or a neutral carrying only unbalanced current in a normally balanced circuit. Count a neutral carrying current comparable to the phase conductors or significant harmonic current from non-linear loads. The Code is silent on spares; VoltDrop counts installed power or lighting spares by default as a conservative reading, not a Code quotation. Your local authority may differ.
entries.translation: Comptez les conducteurs isolés de puissance et d’éclairage. Un conducteur de continuité des masses ne compte jamais. Ne comptez pas les conducteurs de commande ou de signal, ni un neutre qui ne transporte que le courant déséquilibré d’un circuit normalement équilibré. Comptez un neutre qui transporte un courant comparable à celui des phases ou un courant harmonique important provenant de charges non linéaires. Le Code ne précise rien sur les réserves; VoltDrop compte par défaut les réserves de puissance ou d’éclairage installées par prudence, et non comme citation du Code. L’autorité locale peut décider autrement.
entries.backTranslation: Count insulated power and lighting conductors. A bonding conductor never counts. Do not count control or signal conductors, or a neutral that carries only the unbalanced current of a normally balanced circuit. Count a neutral that carries current comparable to the phases or significant harmonic current from nonlinear loads. The Code says nothing about spares; by default VoltDrop counts installed power or lighting spares as a cautious approach, not as a quotation from the Code. The local authority may decide differently.

entries.translation: Cette édition canadienne utilise les courants admissibles de base de CSA C22.1:24 Tables 2/4, les facteurs ambiants de Table 5A, les facteurs de conducteurs de Table 5C, le comptage de Rule 4-004, une vérification prudente et simplifiée des bornes selon Rule 4-006, les plafonds de petits conducteurs de Rule 14-104 et une vérification distincte des charges continues de Rule 8-104.

entries.original: Use the conductor insulation rating for the starting column. Under CEC Rule 4-006, marked equipment uses its marked termination temperature. For unmarked equipment, use 60°C when it is rated not more than 100 A or marked for #1 AWG and smaller, and 75°C above that. The rule applies to the first 1.2 m from a termination and permits a transition beyond it. VoltDrop conservatively applies the lower termination limit throughout as a simplified method.
entries.translation: Utilisez la température nominale de l’isolant du conducteur comme colonne de départ. Selon CEC Rule 4-006, l’équipement marqué utilise la température de borne indiquée. Pour l’équipement non marqué, utilisez 60°C s’il est d’au plus 100 A ou marqué pour #1 AWG et plus petit, et 75°C au-dessus. La règle vise les premiers 1.2 m depuis une borne et permet une transition au-delà. Par prudence, VoltDrop applique la limite de borne inférieure sur toute la longueur comme méthode simplifiée.
entries.backTranslation: Use the conductor insulation rating as the starting column. Under CEC Rule 4-006, marked equipment uses the indicated termination temperature. For unmarked equipment, use 60°C if rated at no more than 100 A or marked for #1 AWG and smaller, and 75°C above that. The rule covers the first 1.2 m from a termination and allows a transition beyond it. As a cautious simplified method, VoltDrop applies the lower termination limit for the full length.
